newsitem.title: USA: North American Mortgage loan applications up.
newsitem.headline: North American Mortgage loan applications up.

text.p: North American Mortgage Co said Friday that its May loan applications were $1.5 billion, a three percent increase over $1.4 billion in May 1996.
May loan fundings were $792 million, compared with May 1996 fundings of $840 million, the company said.

North American Mortgage Co is primarily engaged in the mortgage banking business and, accordingly, originates, acquires, sells and services mortgage loans which are principally first-lien mortgage loans secured by single-family residences.
